[Doc 2] I Will Not Bow: "I Will Not Bow" is the first single by American rock band Breaking Benjamin's 2009 album "Dear Agony". It was featured in the ending credits of the Bruce Willis film "Surrogates". The song was not written specifically for the film, but according to drummer Chad Szeliga, "Ben sent a few songs to our record label, Hollywood Records," which is owned by Disney, who then decided they "wanted a Breaking Benjamin song for this movie." The song was also being used heavily on MLB Network as lead-in and lead-out music during the 2010 MLB postseason.
